title: Wind 金融数据 MCP 配置
description: 填写 Wind API Key 以启用万得金融数据查询，支持股票、债券、基金、指数、宏观数据的查询与分析。Key 仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Wind API Key to enable financial data query and analysis across stocks, bonds, funds, indices, and macro indicators. The key is stored locally at ~/.workbuddy and never leaves your device.
docLabel_en: How to get an API Key?
